name: MTAC 243 90 MAX (MTAC, 90 gr)

ballisticCoefficients.note: G1 BC, printed ".43 est.". Marked est.: estimated, within +/- 5% (page footnote). Page footnote: "Highlighted bullets were tested through the Oehler 43 system"; which bullets is not read. The velocity it applies to is not stated.

sources.note: Page 3, MTAC - Match, Tactical: Caliber .243, Grains 90, Minimum Required Twist *1-8", Part Number MTAC 243 90 MAX, G1 BC .43 est., OAL 1.182", Bullet Projection .818"

note: The twist is marked "*"; page footnote: "*If shooting through transonic, a twist rate increase of 1 inch is recommended (ex: 1:9" instead of 1:10")". Bullet projection (from the SealTite band to the tip, page footnote) printed: .818".
